items.credit: John F. Kennedy, Inaugural Address, 1961 (public domain)
items.title: Ask not

lines.en: And so, my fellow Americans: ask not what your country can do for you, ask what you can do for your country.
lines.ko: 그러니 국민 여러분, 나라가 여러분을 위해 무엇을 할지 묻지 말고, 여러분이 나라를 위해 무엇을 할지 물으십시오.
lines.stress: ASK NOT what your COUNtry can DO for YOU
lines.chunks: And so, my fellow Americans: / ask not / what your country can do for you, / ask what you can do / for your country.

lines.en: I go there to clear my head after work.
